title.value: Schedule events and draft legal documents

introduction.value: Users used Claude Code for scheduling events through Notion MCP and for drafting and analyzing legal documents in markdown.

method.value: The thread itself gives one concrete setup: the poster says they use Claude Desktop for non-coding work by connecting it to Notion through MCP to schedule events, and asks whether to move that work into a Claude Code repository because Claude Code seems better at using tools. A commenter adds a second use case: with Windsurf and Sonnet 3.5, they drafted and analyzed legal documents written in markdown, especially when they were not a lawyer and the documents were in a non-native language.

outcome.value: The source reports qualitative results only: the legal-document workflow was described as very impressive and fast, and the original poster felt Claude Code handled tools better than Claude Desktop. No metrics, completed event-scheduling example, or failures were given.

notes.value: The main catch is how thin the evidence is: this thread is mostly people naming use cases, with no step-by-step workflow or numbers to copy directly.

Schedule events and draft legal documents
Users used Claude Code for scheduling events through Notion MCP and for drafting and analyzing legal documents in markdown.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The thread itself gives one concrete setup: the poster says they use Claude Desktop for non-coding work by connecting it to Notion through MCP to schedule events, and asks whether to move that work into a Claude Code repository because Claude Code seems better at using tools. A commenter adds a second use case: with Windsurf and Sonnet 3.5, they drafted and analyzed legal documents written in markdown, especially when they were not a lawyer and the documents were in a non-native language.
How it went
The source reports qualitative results only: the legal-document workflow was described as very impressive and fast, and the original poster felt Claude Code handled tools better than Claude Desktop. No metrics, completed event-scheduling example, or failures were given.
Worth knowing
The main catch is how thin the evidence is: this thread is mostly people naming use cases, with no step-by-step workflow or numbers to copy directly.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Using my Notion connection, schedule these events: [event details, dates, attendees]. Then draft [type of legal document] in markdown based on [facts and terms], and flag any clauses that need a lawyer's review. Show me the calendar entries and the draft before creating or changing anything in Notion.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1li5nub/anyone_used_claude_code_for_noncoding_tasks
